title: Coromandel Family Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family deals in Coromandel, NZ. Get up to 40% off activities, campervans from $89/day, and free cancellation on holiday parks.
intro: The Coromandel Peninsula is a top destination for families, with its stunning beaches, natural wonders, and exciting activities. To make the most of your trip, we've rounded up the best current deals and discounts. From activity discounts to campervan hire and travel insurance, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Current Deals and Discounts
sections.body:

You can also compare campervan prices from top brands like Jucy, Maui, and Britz on Discover Cars, with prices starting from $89/day. sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Some of the best-value activities in Coromandel include visiting Hot Water Beach, where you can dig your own hot pool in the sand, and exploring the stunning Cathedral Cove. The Driving Creek Railway is also a must-do, with its unique train ride and stunning views.

The Gold Mine Experience Thames is another great activity, where you can learn about the region's gold mining history and even try your hand at panning for gold.
list: Hot Water Beach: free, but $10 parking fee
Cathedral Cove: free, but 35-minute walk from car park
Gold Mine Experience Thames: $25 adult, $15 child

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips
sections.body:
To save even more on your Coromandel holiday, consider visiting during the off-season or booking your activities and accommodation in advance. You can also pack your own food and snacks instead of eating out, and take advantage of free activities like visiting Hahei Beach and the Whitianga waterfront.

Additionally, consider booking a campervan or holiday park instead of a hotel, and look for packages that include activities and accommodation.
list: Visit during the off-season to save up to 20% on accommodation
Book activities and accommodation in advance to avoid peak prices
Pack your own food and snacks to save up to $50/day
Take advantage of free activities like Hahei Beach and Whitianga waterfront
Book a campervan or holiday park instead of a hotel to save up to 30%
Look for packages that include activities and accommodation to save up to 25%
